comparison: Archived deliberation long-context trial, plus two new independently initialized experience trials
recoveryDefinition: After an actually executed excursion returns to an image-observed source, select and execute a different offered entry from the first action on that excursion. Returning is an observed event, not automatically evidence of failure; inspect admitted model goal/progress judgments and independent final objective separately.
directSuccess: Success before any stalled excursion is reported separately; never counted as recovery
safety: Existing filters unchanged; all legitimate revisits and done remain available. No oracle/DOM/human action or feedback in model input.
budgets: Create new ledgers; retain all previous ledgers byte-for-byte. User explicitly authorized ongoing calls; caps are self-imposed.
limitations: Small non-randomized capability runs, not a causal estimate or success rate
Exact observed-image recurrence may miss render changes; it does not establish semantic equivalence
Model self-reported effects are hypotheses; image provenance is not understanding
